sloka: ते विषादार्तवदना रहितास्तेन धिमता ।कृपणाः करुणा वाचो वदन्ति स्म मनस्विनः ॥२-४७-३॥
transliteration: te viṣādārtavadanā rahitāstena dhimatā ।kṛpaṇāḥ karuṇā vāco vadanti sma manasvinaḥ ॥2-47-3॥

translations.english: Those highminded people with sorrowful faces due to separation from sagacious Rama expressed themselves in piteous words:
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के बिना व्याकुल, आते और दीन हो, वे करुणायुक्त वचन कहने लगे
